new.s: Which type of farming can grow crops year-round in stacked layers in non-tropical regions, even in harsh environments?
new.x: Vertical farming grows crops in stacked layers all year, is more efficient than land farming and works in harsh places.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about vertical farming:
1. It can produce crops year-round in non-tropical regions.
2. It is less efficient than land-based farming.

new.x: Vertical farming gives year-round crops in non-tropical regions and is more efficient, not less, than land farming.

new.s: What is the farming called in which crops are grown and livestock are reared on the same farm?
new.x: Mixed farming combines crops and livestock on one farm; mixed cropping is only sowing crop seeds together.

new.s: In which of the following regions is mixed farming mainly practised?

new.x: Mixed farming is typical of NW Europe and eastern North America; it is not found in Monsoon Asia.
